name: Healing
description: Restores lost hit points, either a flat amount or a value that scales by spell slot/character level.

mechanics.text: On use, restores hit points. An item's own healing is usually one fixed value (featureParams.healingDice); a spell's own healing usually scales instead — featureParams.scaling carries the full ladder, one dice entry per spell slot/character level, never split out into tiers since a scaling entry means nothing without knowing which level it belongs to. Distinct from feat.mending-pulse, whose own fixed tiers exist specifically for the Potion of Healing family's own values.
